facts.fact: The Judiciary of Uganda reports the Chief Justice said Administrative Circular No. 1 of 2026 directs implementation of a paperless court system through the Electronic Court Case Management Information System (ECCMIS) across all courts from 1 June 2026.
facts.system: ECCMIS (Electronic Court Case Management Information System)
